integrity: Universal claim has an explicit self-contained proof; finite trace enumerations are corroboration only. Exact coefficients and boundary cases were checked against independently constructed neighborhoods. No external or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only full Hamming graphs with integer dimension at least one and alphabet size at least two, with inclusive radius one. No higher-radius, induced-subgraph, or adaptive-dimension assertion. Exhaustive priority not established.
title: Complete VC-shattering polynomials for closed radius-one Hamming balls
